findings.desc: B-0315 changes the DONE build/version-bump gate so packages/main/tests/** is a watched capability-proof input (done-effects.ts returns true and version-bump-smoke asserts that positive case), but worktree-authority-smoke still keeps packages/main/tests/smoke.ts in the skipped set and asserts isDoneMainRuntimeBuildInput(path) === false. That leaves a core authority smoke encoding the opposite product boundary from this story, so the bounded strategy is not consistently reflected and will fail or mislead gate verification when that smoke runs.

packages/main build skip output still says "no watched runtime inputs changed" (done-effects.ts:205) and existing smoke assertions preserve that old text, while this story expands the watched predicate to include docs/CLI.md and packages/main/tests/** and updates the lifecycle docs/CLI version-bump skip wording to "CLI/runtime or capability contract". This leaves DONE/partial-DONE build skip messaging inconsistent with the new bounded capability/proof policy.

worktree-authority-smoke still encodes the old policy by expecting packages/main/tests/smoke.ts to be a skipped path. Repro: node packages/main/dist/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.js fails with AssertionError: packages/main/tests/smoke.ts must not trigger the post-DONE packages/main build, actual true expected false. This conflicts with B-0315 CHK-001 edge intent that packages/main/tests/** is a positive bump/build input and shows the validation evidence does not cover this maintained smoke.
